scope: Native Shape solid/boundary local/world point wrappers for ball, cuboid, capsule, cone and cylinder, with native fallback for unsupported types.
tolerance_reason: Default native f32 point comparison; independent f64 distance/surface checks allow 8e-6 for two pose transforms and radial reconstruction.
preconditions: Finite inputs, nonnegative dimensions, positive cone height and unit quaternions.
invariants: Exact guards, inside flags and native unsupported-type fallback.
Independent solid membership, closest distance and surface checks.
At the ball center only, native boundary queries return NaN in all coordinates; retain this native singularity and reject NaN everywhere else.
outside_scope: The native Shape wrappers do not project meshes, triangles or general convex shapes; they return the input unchanged.

known_gaps.description: Parry native boundary projection divides by zero at the ball center. The port preserves the native NaN result at this exact input; this is not a TileLang-only deviation.
